title: Vasoactive-Inotropic Score (VIS)
sources: Gaies MG et al. Pediatr Crit Care Med 2010
Koponen T et al. Br J Anaesth 2019
purpose: Single number summarising total vasoactive/inotrope support — for shift-to-shift comparison. Trend it; a single value is not diagnostic.

formulas.label: Vasoactive-Inotropic Score
formulas.expression: dopamine + dobutamine + 100 * epinephrine + 100 * norepinephrine + 10 * milrinone + 10000 * vasopressin

interpretation.label: High support — high-VIS is associated with worse outcomes in the validation cohorts

notes: Enter 0 for agents not running. Some published versions add phenylephrine (×100) and use norepinephrine ×100 — the coefficient set here follows the common adult adaptation. Bands are approximate and cohort-dependent.
